verdict.rationale: Poly documents sharing files and folders with specific people (owner keeps control and can revoke access), plus Shared Drives that act as team storage spaces with their own members and roles. That covers the 'share a space with collaborators' half of the story. For simultaneous editing, the only evidence is that conflicting edits are preserved and recoverable: no data is lost, but there is no documented real-time co-editing or merge. Missing for 10: documented real-time or concurrent collaborative note editing, conflict merge or lock behavior beyond version preservation, explicit edit-permission details for shared items, and independent hands-on corroboration.
